objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, review, release, and archival in the policy and guidelines management system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally-defined or business-process-specific regulations and instructions.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, steps, and responsible persons within a process.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for a document type, optionally selected during document creation.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role with creation and modification permissions on a document and its details.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with modification rights on a document but no significance in the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content against technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving a document for distribution to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with view-only access to approved documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released content into another language.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document linked to a main document, released with it and subject to the main document's version cycle.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary material attached to a document, not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document that does not affect the content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review whether a document's validity should be extended, created 30 days before validity expiration.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document or confirmation workflows.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group with read-only access to archived documents during the archive retention period.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A company division or department to which documents may be assigned for applicability.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system that may be referenced by or relevant to a document.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned the same role or access rights within the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document being created.

attributes.name: template_selection
attributes.description: Optional predefined structure selected during creation.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Add or edit standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes of a document, organized by category.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The thematic grouping of attributes and metadata.

attributes.name: attribute
attributes.description: The specific metadata field being maintained.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Modify the document's content using an editing client, with optional automatic insertion of metadata tags.

attributes.name: office_format
attributes.description: The source format (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) of the document being edited.

attributes.name: tag_technology
attributes.description: Automated insertion of metadata such as version and status into document content.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document content to PDF format after saving, for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define read and change rights for users or user groups on a document at the group and person level.

attributes.name: permission_type
attributes.description: The category of permission assigned (Reader, Author, Co-author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose amendments to an existing document without affecting the version history, initiated after the first version is released.

attributes.name: proposed_change
attributes.description: The content or property alteration being suggested.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept and schedule a change proposal, triggering the creation of a new document version with the proposed changes applied.

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Begin the 3-step approval workflow (Creator - Review - Release) by a co-author or the author.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The stage of the approval process being initiated.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Complete a workflow step using an electronic signature, performed by author, reviewer, or releaser.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: The electronic signature of the completing participant.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content against technical and formal aspects, performed by designated reviewers.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review aspect being checked.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and finalize a document for publication and distribution to readers, performed by designated releaser(s).

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: The document visibility status after release.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to addressed readers in the system.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an existing released document in editing status, retaining all previous data with possible modifications.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as no longer relevant, with physical archiving occurring after release of the next main document version.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and user groups of a new document version release via email notification.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Solicit active workflow-supported confirmation of document receipt from distribution list recipients without requiring a signature.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_type
attributes.description: The confirmation of document understanding by the recipient.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm that a document remains valid, updating the validity expiration date by the default period and deleting the validity extension request.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expiration, prompting review for continued validity.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to invalidate a document that has no further validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Finalize the invalidation of a document and its attachments, revoking user authorizations and initiating archival.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw user authorizations for a document, maintaining read access only for the archive group during the retention period.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Remove an archived document from the system after the archive retention period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to restore a previously invalidated document to valid status, only permitted by the Business Admin group.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an invalidated document and its attachments, restoring authorizations and creating a new version for release.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language, subject to review and release workflow.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and finalize a translated document version for visibility to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: display_content
evts.description: Present document details including attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions in a reader view.

o2o.description: A document is created by optionally selecting and using a template.
A document may have one or more attachments linked to it.
A document may be supplemented with one or more additional information objects.
A change proposal is clearly associated with and displayed within a single document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document being reviewed.
An override request is created for and linked to a specific document.
A reactivation request specifies which document to restore.
Documents can reference other documents and can be linked to create extended local versions.
A document may be assigned to specific organizational units for localized applicability.
A document may reference relevant IT applications as part of its properties.
An author has creation and modification rights on a document.
A co-author has modification rights on a document but no workflow significance.
A reviewer is assigned to check specific documents.
A releaser is assigned responsibility for approving specific documents.
A reader is authorized to view specific approved documents.
A translator is assigned to translate released documents into specific languages.
User groups can be nested, with subgroups assigned to parent groups.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups and persons.
A distribution list is maintained for each document to govern email and acknowledgement distribution.

o2e.description: A new document is created by attaching a new information object.
An optional template is selected during document creation.
Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained via properties.
Document content is edited using an editing client.
A document is automatically converted to PDF format.
An author is assigned personal authorization as a document participant.
A co-author is assigned personal modification authorization.
A reviewer is assigned personal authorization via properties.
A releaser is assigned personal authorization via properties.
Reader authorization is assigned via user group assignment.
Translator authorization is assigned via properties.
User group authorizations are assigned for reader access.
A change proposal is created for an existing document after its first release.
An author creates a change proposal without affecting version history.
A scheduled change proposal triggers creation of a new document version.
An author or co-author initiates the release workflow.
A document enters the 3-step release workflow.
The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step.
Assigned reviewers sign the document during the review step.
Assigned releasers sign the document during the release step.
A document is reviewed by assigned reviewers.
A reviewer checks document content.
A document is approved for publication by assigned releaser(s).
A releaser approves and finalizes a document.
A released document is made visible to readers.
A released document is revised by creating a new editing version.
An author creates a new version of a document.
An attachment is marked for archival.
Assigned users and user groups are notified of a new document version.
Users in assigned user groups receive email notification.
The distribution list determines which users receive notifications.
A document release may solicit active acknowledgement from recipients.
Readers are requested to confirm receipt of a document.
Users in assigned groups receive acknowledgement requests.
A document's validity is extended by updating its expiration date.
A releaser performs validity extension in process 1.
Authors participate in validity extension in process 2.
Reviewers participate in validity extension in process 2.
The system generates a validity extension request when a document approaches expiration.
A request to override a document is created by a user with write access.
A document is invalidated and archived through the override workflow.
A releaser approves override in process 1.
The request creator reviews the override request in process 2.
Reviewers check the override request in process 2.
A document is archived after override, revoking authorizations.
The archive group retains read access to archived documents.
A document is physically deleted after the archive retention period expires.
A request to reactivate an archived document is created.
An invalidated document is restored to valid status.
The reactivation request creator performs the reactivation workflow step.
Attachments archived with a document are also reactivated.
Released document content is translated into another language.
A translator translates released documents.
A translated version of a document is reviewed and released.
A translator's work may be reviewed and released.
Reviewers check translated content.
A releaser approves translated versions.
Document details and content are presented in a reader view.
